title: How to Update Website's Phone Number | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Update Website's Phone Number Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000048777 To update the website's phone number that displays on the mini header section, please follow the steps below: Go to: Settings » General Settings » General » Website Phone Number For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
